Australian Students Protest Against Pauline Hanson

Students across Australia participated in protests against politician Pauline Hanson. University students and high schoolers joined walkouts in major cities and smaller locations. Protesters were urged to 'stand up against the far right'. Some calls were made for striking students to remain in school.
